headline: TRUMP 🦅 PLANS to CUT OFF 💇‍♂️ Military AID to KURDISH 🛡️ ALLY
text:
TRUMP 🦅 administration is about to GHOST 💔 the KURDS 🐺 who literally CARRIED 🏋️ the whole anti-ISIS ☠️ campaign on their backs only to get RAILED 💦 by Iranian 🚀 DRONES 🛰️ smashing into Irbil 🏙️ like it's going out of style!! Pentagon 🏛️ officials straight up TOLD 🗣️ Kurdish leaders in closed door MEETINGS 🤝 that they are NOT 🙅 renewing the expiring security pact that keeps the PESHMERGA 🛡️ fed with weapons 🔫 training 🏋️ and cold hard cash 💵!! Four sources deep in the know spilled to BBC 📺 on total ANON 🕵️ vibes because this bombshell hasn't DROPPED 💣 anywhere yet and the whole room was left SWEATING 😰 at the implications bro!! "We are getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 here" one insider whispered while staring at maps 📍 covered in missile 🧨 craters from Tehran 🔥!!

Kurdish officials are DOWN BAD 😵 right now fearing a massive POWER VACUUM 🕳️ that will let Iran 🇮🇷 roll in even harder after HUNDREDS 💯 of missiles ☄️ and drones 🛸 have already turned Iraqi Kurdistan into a shooting gallery 🎯!! The memorandum of understanding signed back in 2016 📅 and renewed in 2022 is set to flatline on September 30th 🗓️ exactly when the last coalition troops bounce from Iraq leaving the sole US base in Irbil 🏠 to shutter forever!! Peshmerga forces numbering around 180000 strong 🪖 got 61 million dollars 💰 last fiscal year for stipends and gear but now the 2027 budget wants to SLASH ✂️ it all claiming ISIS ☠️ is cooked so reallocate that cheddar 🧀 somewhere else!! Analysts are SCREAMING 📢 this move would SCREW 🔩 a longtime partner and scream to every ally that Washington cannot be TRUSTED 🤝!!

Yerevan Saeed from the Global Kurdish Initiative dropped a TRUTH BOMB 💥 saying "The US would be cutting off the Kurds who shed so much BLOOD 🩸 to help the Americans achieve their goals in Iraq and the wider Middle East"!! He warned this is going to be a HUGE WIN 🏆 for Iran 🇮🇷 China 🇨🇳 and Russia 🇷🇺 if the Kurds get left swinging in the wind 🍃 with no cover!! Trump in his second term has been edging toward less foreign entanglements 🌍 while simultaneously launching a six month long war with Tehran that shows ZERO signs of stopping any time soon!! The Pentagon's own statement after Pete Hegseth met Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi basically said "you guys handle the terrorists now" which left Kurdish leaders feeling proper GHOSTED 👻!!

Recent talks between Defense Department suits and both Iraqi plus Kurdish officials confirmed the US is NOT 🙅 planning to extend that precious memorandum of understanding even though Iranian backed militias have launched 158 attacks 🎯 by late May alone according to the Foundation for Defense of Democracies think tank 📊!! The $800 million monster consulate 🏛️ in Irbil that America just opened last December was supposed to be a big flex 💪 on how much they value the relationship but now it feels like a cruel joke 😂 with troop withdrawal locked in for October 1st!! James Jeffrey the guy who ran the global coalition against ISIS in Trump's first term called it "money well spent" and reminded everyone what happened last time a power vacuum let Islamic State roll into northern Iraq like it was nothing!!

Tom Barrack acting as the main US voice on Iraq alongside White House Defense and State Department bigwigs has been deep in these convos but the final call on future security engagement is still under review 📝 with some vague talk about maybe keeping a few support channels open after everyone pulls out!! Iraqi Prime Minister al-Zaidi who met Trump at the White House in July has been hyping the withdrawal as "a new day" for Iraq free of foreign boots 👢 yet everyone with half a brain knows this leaves the Peshmerga frontline fighters even more exposed to Iranian drones 🛰️ and missiles than ever before!! The whole saga is peak "we used you then dipped" energy and the Kurds are sitting there wondering if their blood payments 🩸 finally cleared the bank or not!! Sources say the administration is still open to some bilateral security pact with Baghdad but Kurdish role in that remains a giant question mark ❓ floating over the desert sand dunes 🏜️!!
